title: Scientists discover stunning new Amazon fish that may already be endangered
caption:
A dazzling new killifish species, Laimosemion laranja, was discovered in just three tiny Amazon pools. Its brilliant orange pattern hides a fragile future, as mining and deforestation threaten its home. Conservation of these hidden ponds could keep the colors alive.

Source: Sciencedaily - Scientists discover stunning new Amazon fish that may already be endangered

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261104084019.htm
